sentences.text: Iconic-Team Oy is a company registered on 2026-07-17 under the industry code 30110, building of civilian ships and floating structures.
A start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-07-17, and a first hire and first sales are recorded on 2026-08-01.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the registered industry is on the thesis list, but no public record yet shows technology or growth.
